subject.title: fix(release): ClawHub CLI materialization fails on npm 12

question: Should release automation standardize on invoking `npm ci` from the copied pinned project, after confirming the existing supported npm baseline still produces the identical locked ClawHub CLI?
rationale: The `maintainer` label requires explicit handling, and this script controls a pinned release dependency whose install semantics must remain stable across npm versions.

options.title: Confirm both npm paths and merge
options.body: Run or review materialization evidence on the current supported npm baseline and npm 12, then accept the destination-working-directory invocation.

options.title: Use a different npm 12-compatible approach
options.body: Keep the existing invocation shape only if release owners identify a documented npm compatibility method that preserves the lockfile contract more clearly.

recommendation.title: Confirm both npm paths and merge
recommendation.body: Run or review materialization evidence on the current supported npm baseline and npm 12, then accept the destination-working-directory invocation.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to steipete and its only commit changes the release materializer.
